pending_commit.commit_message: tast: Introduce chromeos-base/tast-build-deps. This CL introduces the chromeos-base/tast-build-deps package where build time dependencies of all Tast related binaries (test runners and test bundles) are put. This package resolves a few problems about interaction between Portage and Tast: - Portage has a bug that --onlydeps-with-rdeps=n is ignored in a certain situation (https://bugs.gentoo.org/682472) and Tast had to work around the bug in a hacky and incomplete way when installing build time dependencies. The hack is no longer required after introduction of this package since the new package has no runtime-only dependency. - Formerly users were prompted to emerge dependencies even just after running update_chroot because local test dependencies were not installed to the host, adding tens of seconds to the runtime of the tast command. Now those dependencies are installed by update_chroot, so there is no need of additional emerge. make_chroot: Pass $USEPKG and $USEPKGONLY when building glibc/binutils. Toolchain packages like glibc, binutils etc. should only be built from source when "--nousepkg" is passed. Linux-headers is also in this list as it matches the exisiting behavior of crossdev's cross-* packages. Define a new USEPKGONLY variable and use it to force toolchain packages from being built from source. This fixes the reported issue of glibc being built from source when entering a newly created chroot. BUG=chromium:976914 TEST=glibc not built when entering a new chroot. FIXUP: FROMLIST: ASoC: SOF: Add Sound Open Firmware driver core If CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF=y and CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC=m, builds fail with ld: sound/soc/sof/core.o: in function `sof_machine_check': >> sound/soc/sof/core.c:269: undefined reference to `sof_nocodec_setup' ld: sound/soc/sof/sof-acpi-dev.o: in function `sof_acpi_probe': >> sound/soc/sof/sof-acpi-dev.c:220: undefined reference to `sof_nocodec_setup' This happens because sof_nocodec_setup() is called from code built into the kernel but resides in a module. Since sof_nocodec_setup() is called unconditionally from the SOF core if CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_FORCE_NOCODEC_MODE=y, SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC must be built into the kernel if SND_SOC_SOF=y. Add the necessary dependency. sof_nocodec_setup() is called from sof-acpi-dev.c:sof_acpi_probe() if CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_FORCE_NOCODEC_MODE=y. This results in the second build failure if SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC=m and SND_SOC_SOF_ACPI=y. Since we force SND_SOC_SOF_NOCODEC=y if SND_SOC_SOF=y, and SND_SOC_SOF is selected by SND_SOC_SOF_ACPI, this problem is solved with the above change as well. This change does not affect existing Chrome OS configurations and thus does not have functional impact on shipping images. tast: Remove -checktestdeps=auto flag value. -checktestdeps controls the behavior to skip tests by checking software dependencies. Formerly the flag had three values: always, never, auto. The auto value, which was actually the default when the flag is not explicitly specified, indicates that software deps should be checked if and only if tests are specified by attribute expressions (e.g. "(!disabled)") rather than exact names (e.g. "arc.Boot") or globs (e.g. "arc.*"). Since this behavior is confusing, this CL changes the flag to accept a boolean value, and sets the default to always checking software dependencies. Fortunately, there is no use of the flag in production today: http://cs/search/?q=%22-checktestdeps%22 BUG=chromium:971486 TEST=fast_build.sh -T TEST=fast_build.sh && ~/go/bin/tast run betty arc.Boot audio.DevicePlay Change-Id: I3edb2eaca0ccd84f5826eb75362000d482906c27 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1666817 Tested-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Keigo Oka <oka@chromium.org>
